descriptionEn: Channel to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed Melee Attack once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform Channelled Skills or Conditional Skills. Consuming a Power Charge creates additional images.
summaryPt: Canalize pra criar imagens astrais suas que usam a skill melee encaixada (Whirling Assault) uma vez. Consumir Power Charge cria imagens extras.
wherePt: Concedida pela ascendência Hollow Form Technique.
